members.name: options

references.name: SelectOption

members.description: The unified select option list. Each option has a label and non-empty value, may be disabled, and can include custom fields used for grouping.

members.name: groupField
members.description: The option field used to group items. When omitted, options are displayed as a flat list.

members.name: groupLabel
members.description: The field on the first option of each group used as its heading; when omitted or absent, the groupField value is used.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Placeholder text shown before an option is selected; when omitted, the localized select.placeholder message is used.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the select root state and its built-in trigger.

members.name: required
members.description: Marks the select as required; the unified trigger hides its clear action while required is true.

members.name: name
members.description: The form field name passed to SelectRoot.

members.name: id
members.description: The DOM ID for the built-in trigger. With a custom trigger slot, the slot content supplies its own ID.

members.name: size
members.description: The size variant of the built-in trigger.

members.name: variant
members.description: The border and state variant of the built-in trigger.

members.name: errorMessage
members.description: The error message passed to the built-in trigger for its error-state semantics.

members.name: clearable
members.description: Allows the built-in trigger to show a clear action when a value is selected; the action is disabled when required is true.

members.name: position
members.description: Sets how the options panel is positioned relative to the trigger.

members.name: class
members.description: Custom CSS classes merged onto the built-in trigger together with triggerClass.

members.name: triggerClass
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the built-in trigger.

members.name: contentClass
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the options panel.

members.name: itemVariant
members.description: The variant applied to each SelectItem generated from options.

members.name: modelValue
members.description: The currently selected string value, controlled with v-model; it may be undefined when nothing is selected.

members.name: update:modelValue
members.description: Emits the new value when the selection changes; the built-in clear action emits undefined.

members.name: default
members.description: Replaces the entire Select content. When provided, the component renders neither its built-in trigger nor the options panel, so the slot must compose the primitives itself.

members.name: trigger
members.description: Replaces the built-in trigger while the options panel is still generated from options. The slot receives no arguments.

members.name: position
members.description: Controls how the content panel is positioned relative to its trigger.

members.name: class
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the floating content panel.

members.name: default
members.description: Renders options, groups, and other content-panel children.

members.name: value
members.description: The non-empty, unique string value of this option, used as the selection result.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Prevents the user from selecting this option.

members.name: variant
members.description: The visual variant for this option.

members.name: class
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the option root element.

members.name: indicatorClass
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the selected-state indicator.

members.name: iconClass
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the selected check icon.

members.name: iconSize
members.description: Sets the size of the selected check icon.

members.name: default
members.description: The content displayed in the option text area.

members.name: class
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the group heading element.

members.name: default
members.description: The group heading text or other heading content.

members.name: class
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the scroll-down indicator control.

members.name: iconSize
members.description: Sets the size of the scroll-down arrow icon.

members.name: class
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the scroll-up indicator control.

members.name: iconSize
members.description: Sets the size of the scroll-up arrow icon.

members.name: decorative
members.description: Declares whether the separator is decorative; the primitive hides decorative separators from the accessibility tree.

members.name: class
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the separator element.

members.name: size
members.description: The trigger size variant, which also determines the mapped dropdown icon size.

members.name: variant
members.description: The trigger border and state variant.

members.name: errorMessage
members.description: The error-state message associated with the trigger when it is invalid.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the trigger and its clear action.

members.name: id
members.description: The DOM ID of the native trigger button.

members.name: clearable
members.description: Allows the clear button to appear when a value is selected and the trigger is enabled.

members.name: modelValue
members.description: The current value, used to determine whether there is a selection to clear.

members.name: class
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the trigger button.

members.name: iconClass
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the dropdown indicator icon.

members.name: clear
members.description: Emitted when the user activates the clear action; the event carries no payload.

members.name: default
members.description: The trigger content, usually including SelectValue.
